verdict.rationale: New Relic documents 'logs in context': its APM agents add metadata to logs so log data appears in relevant places across the platform, and its log management ties into traces. However, the evidence never explicitly shows jumping from a specific trace span to its correlated logs, or from a span to metrics, for end-to-end request debugging. Missing for 10: explicit span-to-log navigation, span-to-metrics correlation, a documented end-to-end request debugging workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: add metadata to your logs, which gives you logs in context (ability to see logs data in various relevant places in our platform)

Our log management solution provides deeper visibility into application and infrastructure performance data (events, errors, traces, and more) to reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR) and quickly troubleshoot production incidents.
